stories.headline: Flawed simulators expose overconfident research agents

source.title: SciResearch-Eval: Evaluating Scientific Judgment in Autonomous Experimental Agents
source.publisher: Brian T. Weston, Alondra Torres Contreras and Aldair E. Gongora
source.scope: Reviewed the complete 28-page paper, held-out and preregistered splits, simulator-mismatch setup, interval scoring, diagnosis rates, effort ablation, token tradeoffs and stated limitations.
source.freshness_reason: Within 72 hours; selected as a fresh original paper with methods, results, limitations and released evaluation code.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete 28-page paper, held-out and preregistered splits, simulator-mismatch setup, interval scoring, diagnosis rates, effort ablation, token tradeoffs and stated limitations.

stories.summary: SciResearch-Eval tests agents that design thermal experiments while relying on a simulator that can be under-resolved or physically wrong. Across 2,511 held-out episodes, many models reported narrow but incorrect intervals when physics was missing. Safer experiment design, not simply wider intervals, separated better-calibrated systems, with substantial reasoning-cost tradeoffs.
stories.why_it_matters: Agent builders can use this benchmark pattern to test whether a system notices flawed tools, chooses robust experiments and calibrates uncertainty. Record interval coverage, diagnostic behavior and reasoning cost instead of accepting a correct-looking point estimate.
stories.related_coverage: Fresh original-paper discovery from the arXiv and Hugging Face daily-paper indexes; full methods and limitations reviewed.
stories.image_alt_intent: A research agent chooses heating experiments beside a visibly flawed thermal simulator while calibrated confidence intervals reveal whether the true material properties remain covered.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the complete Sales plugin release, account research, meeting preparation, partner-plugin, dot-agent, follow-up, CRM-update, administrator setup, availability and customer-example sections, plus the source-checking instructions.

stories.summary: ChatGPT for Sales packages account research, meeting preparation, proposal and follow-up workflows across connected sales tools. Its always-on dot can prepare briefs and propose next steps, while partner availability and permissions vary. Customer efficiency claims are vendor-provided, so the most transferable value is a source-linked review procedure before any message or CRM change.

stories.related_coverage: Top 10 sales-agent event; full original release and administrator setup guidance reviewed.

audience_fit.intended_user: Sales representatives, account managers and operations owners using ordinary CRM, meeting and document tools.
audience_fit.practical_action: Request a source-linked account brief from approved systems, then draft the follow-up and proposed CRM update without sending either.
audience_fit.review_action: Verify account history, open commitments and record links, correct the brief, and separately approve any external message or data change.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A reusable checked briefing packet preserves sources, corrections, approved next steps and the final record update for the next meeting.

stories.agent_skills_evidence: Reusable noncoding procedure: connect only approved account sources, request a meeting brief with record links, verify history and commitments, correct unsupported statements, draft but do not send the follow-up, review the proposed CRM change, approve each action separately, and retain the checked packet for reuse.

OpenAI's primary release connects the new model to professional-output examples, token efficiency, pricing and safeguards needed for a knowledge-work evaluation; the considered engineering sources do not support that applied workflow decision.

Although older than the launch-day candidates, Anthropic's methodology uniquely gives teams a concrete framework for construct validity, grader validation, causal designs and reporting uncertainty, so its durable governance value justified the bounded 168-hour fallback.

Google's dated rollout is the only reviewed candidate documenting consumer task actions, confirmation boundaries, privacy controls and geographic limits for a noncoding agent workflow; the newer engineering items offer no equivalent everyday-agent evidence.

The Sales release contains the primary plugin setup, source-checking directions, CRM handoff and administrator controls needed for today's single reusable Agent Skills procedure; the considered model and paper candidates lack this distinct practical action and outcome.
